proposals.name: objdelta
proposals.tagline: Structural diffs and immutable patches for plain JavaScript data.
proposals.concept: Compute exactly what changed between two values as a list of path-addressed operations, replay those operations on a value without mutating it, and print them for humans. Useful for undo/redo, audit logs, syncing state and readable test failures.
proposals.newCapability: diff/patch: equality tells where values differ, cloning makes the patched result independent. Round-trip guarantee: patch(a, diff(a, b)) equals b, and a is untouched.
proposals.whyItIsNew: dequal only says 'different'; klona only copies. Together they can say what is different and produce a new value with exactly those changes.

api.name: equal
api.description: Deep equality for objects, arrays, Date, RegExp, Map, Set and NaN.

api.name: clone
api.description: Deep, independent copy including Date, RegExp, Map and Set.

api.name: diff
api.signature: diff(before: unknown, after: unknown): Array<{ op: 'add'|'remove'|'replace', path: Array<string|number>, value?: unknown }>
api.description: Operations that turn before into after. Object keys follow before's order, then new keys; extra array items are added in order or removed from the end.

api.name: patch
api.description: Applies operations to a deep clone of value. Never mutates its inputs; inserted values are cloned.

proposals.name: snapshot-guard
proposals.tagline: Detect when code mutated data it should not have.
proposals.concept: Clone a value before calling a function, compare afterwards, and report mutations.
proposals.whyItIsNew: Combines a before-snapshot with an equality check into a guard.

api.name: guard
api.description: Runs fn and reports whether arguments changed.

proposals.name: dedupe-deep
proposals.tagline: Remove structurally duplicate items from collections.
proposals.concept: Deduplicate arrays of objects by deep equality and return independent copies.
